FROM partner_managements LEFT JOIN type_network_partner_managements ON type_network_partner_managements.id = partner_managements.type_network_id AND type_network_partner_managements.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN class_partner_managements ON class_partner_managements.id = partner_managements.class_id AND class_partner_managements.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN partner_management_industries ON partner_management_industries.id = partner_managements.industry_id LEFT JOIN partner_management_positions ON partner_management_positions.id = partner_managements.position_id LEFT JOIN employees ON employees.id = partner_managements.person_in_charge_id AND employees.is_active = 1

WHERE partner_managements.is_active = 1 AND partner_managements.class_id = #{classId} AND partner_managements.type_network_id = #{typeNetworkId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM class_egroup_partner_managements cepm
INNER JOIN employee_egroups ee ON ee.egroup_id = cepm.egroup_id INNER JOIN employees current_employee ON current_employee.id = ee.employee_id AND current_employee.is_active = 1 WHERE cepm.class_id = partner_managements.class_id AND current_employee.user_id = #{userId} )
AND ( partner_managements.partner_area_expertise LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR partner_managements.partner_name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR partner_managements.key_contact_name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR partner_managements.key_contact_tel LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR partner_managements.key_contact_email LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR partner_managements.why LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR type_network_partner_managements.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR class_partner_managements.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR partner_management_industries.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR partner_management_positions.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR partner_managements.origin LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR partner_managements.ref_by LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR partner_managements.relationship LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR employees.name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") )
